description: Send one real push notification to the given app users, to prove the chain works before an automation depends on it. Confirm with the user first: this reaches actual phones.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

userIds.description: App user ids to notify (the same ids row-level security uses)

name: send_test_push
